name: firm
description: Thin Mission/Wave and autonomous Agent Team integration for Kimi Code.

interface.shortDescription: Plan Missions and coordinate autonomous Agent Teams.
interface.longDescription: Adds provider-neutral Host and Member skills, Harness MCP registration, lifecycle status hooks, CLI shortcuts, and Dashboard deep links. Product state remains in Harness and provider execution remains in native sessions.

skillInstructions: Use the Firm CLI as the complete path. Mission stores durable intent; Wave stores Host plan and judgment; Agent Team Works store responsibility, status, submission, and Host acceptance; TeamMessage is Work-linked conversation only. Members may use provider-native subagents internally, provider pauses use PendingInteraction, and provider-native sessions remain execution truth.
